eu-ecj.notice.WORK/IS_ABOUT: the subject concepts flattened out of the chains that state their depth
eu-ecj.notice.WORK/LASTMODIFICATIONDATE: when the repository last touched the record, which moves when the Office re-indexes
eu-ecj.notice.WORK/PART_OF: the container work under a generic name; its coordinates are read from the container itself
eu-ecj.notice.WORK/RESOURCE_LEGAL_NUMBER_NATURA: the case number digits of the CELEX number, which the CELEX number carries
eu-ecj.notice.WORK/RESOURCE_LEGAL_YEAR: the year digits of the CELEX number, which the CELEX number carries
eu-ecj.notice.WORK/SAMEAS: the CELEX and ECLI forms of this work's address, both read from their own fields
eu-ecj.notice.WORK/TYPE: the ontology classes of the record, which describe the repository's model rather than the decision
eu-ecj.notice.WORK/URI: the repository address of the work, which the row holds as the address the document was served from
eu-ecj.notice.WORK/WORK_HAS_EXPRESSION: the other language expressions of this work, each of which is a row of its own
eu-ecj.notice.WORK/WORK_ID_DOCUMENT: the CELEX number with its scheme prefixed
eu-ecj.notice.WORK/WORK_PART_OF_DOSSIER/CONTAIN: the works of the case file under a generic relation, which the case event lists
eu-ecj.notice.WORK/WORK_PART_OF_DOSSIER/DOSSIER: this decision restated as a member of its own case file
the docket without its scheme, which the case-file identifier carries whole
that the file is a case, which is the scheme its identifier already names
eu-ecj.notice.WORK/WORK_PART_OF_DOSSIER/PART_OF: the case file the delivery event belongs to, which the case-file identifier names
eu-ecj.notice.WORK/WORK_PART_OF_DOSSIER/TYPE: the ontology classes of the case-file record
eu-ecj.notice.WORK/WORK_PART_OF_WORK/CONTAINS: the decisions the Reports volume holds, which are documents of their own
eu-ecj.notice.WORK/WORK_PART_OF_WORK/EXPRESSION: the title of the Reports volume, not of the decision
the language the Reports volume's own title is given in
eu-ecj.notice.WORK/WORK_PART_OF_WORK/NUMBER: the container number under a generic name
eu-ecj.notice.WORK/WORK_PART_OF_WORK/TYPE: the ontology classes of the container record
eu-ecj.notice.WORK/WORK_PART_OF_WORK/WORK_DATE_: the decision date restated on its container
eu-ecj.notice.WORK/WORK_PART_OF_WORK/WORK_HAS_R: that the container is the Reports of Cases, which its coordinates already name
eu-ecj.notice.WORK/YEAR: the case year under a generic name
eu-ecj.notice.EXPRESSION/CREATIONDATE: when the repository first held this translation's record
eu-ecj.notice.EXPRESSION/EXPRESSION_BELONGS_TO_: the work this translation belongs to, which is what the row is keyed by
eu-ecj.notice.EXPRESSION/EXPRESSION_CASE-LAW_PA: the parties' names, which the decision's own text carries and bounds
eu-ecj.notice.EXPRESSION/EXPRESSION_MANIFESTED_: the formats of this translation without their types, which the format records state
eu-ecj.notice.EXPRESSION/LANG: the two-letter form of this translation's language, which the language concept states
eu-ecj.notice.EXPRESSION/LASTMODIFICATIONDATE: when the repository last touched this translation's record
eu-ecj.notice.EXPRESSION/PARTIES: the parties' names under a generic name
eu-ecj.notice.EXPRESSION/SAMEAS: the CELEX and ECLI forms of this translation's address
eu-ecj.notice.EXPRESSION/TITLE: the translated title under a generic name
eu-ecj.notice.EXPRESSION/URI: the repository address of this translation
eu-ecj.notice.MANIFESTATION/CREATIONDATE: when the repository first held this format's record
eu-ecj.notice.MANIFESTATION/LASTMODIFICATIONDAT: when the repository last touched this format's record
eu-ecj.notice.MANIFESTATION/MANIFESTATION_HAS_I: the numbered items of the format, which the content stream resolves on request
eu-ecj.notice.MANIFESTATION/MANIFESTATION_MANIF: the translation this format belongs to, which is this row's
eu-ecj.notice.MANIFESTATION/SAMEAS: the CELEX and ECLI forms of this format's address
eu-ecj.notice.MANIFESTATION/TYPE: the ontology classes of the format record
eu-ecj.formex.body: the same decision text the document part carries, in the publisher's semantic encoding; the part is kept so a later parse can be checked against it rather than read into the row today

hu-bhgy.Szoveg: always null on a listing row; the decision's text is the downloaded document
hu-bhgy.RezumeSzovegKornyezet: keyword-search highlight over Rezume, which is stored whole
hu-bhgy.NemHivatkozhatoSzoveg: null on every row the search serves; the citability filter changes no count it reports
hu-bhgy.DownloadLink: always null; the download URL is rebuilt from IndexId, Azonosito and MeghozoBirosag

pl-kis.POZIOM_DOSTEPU_WYBRANEJ_TRESCI: which of the service's editor groups may see a part of the document; it says nothing about the document
pl-kis.informacja/id: the same id ID_INFORMACJI states, which keys the row
pl-kis.informacja/nazwa: the category's name, which KATEGORIA_INFORMACJI states
pl-kis.informacja/informacjaTytulDto: an empty list on every document observed; the title is TEZA

pl-uodo.type: the record format's own name; every record the search returns carries the same value
pl-uodo.version: the version of the record format, not a fact about the document

pl-uokik.listing.@position: the row's place in a view that shifts with every decision published; the crawl reads it, the row does not keep it
pl-uokik.listing.@siblings: the view's size, the same on every row; the total probe reads it
pl-uokik.listing.entrydata: the column container; each value in it is declared below
